items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: This last time he had John Faddis playing with Eubie U.B. Blake.

ctx.x: with all the time. That was the real challenge. It was easy to play with somebody you play with every night, but the real sessions, they wouldn't let nobody do that in most of the real sessions. You had to play with what was there and do your best with it.

That's why I like this thing up at Colorado, you know. He might put you on with anybody. He might put on a swing guy up there with some modern guys. A couple of swing guys. And it's a challenge. You never know who you're going to play with. This last time he had John Faddis playing with Eubie U.B. Blake. John Faddis is 22 and U.B. Blake is 94. And they tore up the house. They played -- they played the most beautiful thing on "Memories of You", the thing that -- it's going to be in the movie -- in that movie he's…
